subject: [PATCH v4 3/3] fs/proc/task_mmu: account device-private PMDs as present in smaps

2026-11-25.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue where device-private PMDs were not being accounted for correctly in the smaps output, leading to incorrect PSS and private/shared mapping counts. The problem was that smaps_pmd_entry() passed present=false to smaps_account(), treating these mappings as migration entries rather than actual mapped pages. To fix this, the patch modifies smaps_pmd_entry() to mark device-private PMDs as present, allowing smaps_account() to use mapcounts for PSS and private/shared accounting.
